$script = @'
# Proper Mandelbrot ASCII Art Generator
param($width=120, $height=60)

$xMin, $xMax = -2.5, 1.0
$yMin, $yMax = -1.5, 1.5
$maxIterations = 80

# Build character set for iteration mapping
$chars = "⊞⊟⊠⊡○●◎◉✦❖☻★☆☂✎❀⊥⊇⊈⊩⊪⊫⊬⊭⊮⊯⊰⊱⊲⊳⊴⊵⊶⊷⊸⊹⊺⊻⊼⊽⊾⊿"

Write-Output "Generating Mandelbrot set ASCII art..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Output ""

$progress = [System.Diagnostics.ProgressBar]::new(0, $height)

foreach ($y in 0..($height-1)) {
    $row = []
    
    for ($x = 0; $x -lt $width; $x++) {
        # Map pixel coordinates to complex plane
        $realCoord = $xMin + (($x / [double]$width) * ($xMax - $xMin))
        $imagCoord = $yMin + (($y / [double]$height) * ($yMax - $yMin))
        
        $cReal, $cImag = $realCoord, $imagCoord
        $zReal, $zImag = 0, 0
        
        $iterations = 0
        while ($iterations -lt $maxIterations -and ($zReal*$zReal + $zImag*$zImag) -le 4) {
            $tempReal = $zReal * $zReal - $zImag * $zImag + $cReal
            $tempImag = 2 * $zReal * $zImag + $cImag
            $zReal, $zImag = $tempReal, $tempImag
            $iterations++
        }
        
        # Map iterations to character from palette
        $index = [math]::Min($maxIterations, (int)($iterations * ($chars.Length / $maxIterations)))
        $char = $chars.Substring($index, 1)
        
        # Add escape sequence for color based on iteration density
        if ($iterations -ge $maxIterations -and $x % 40 -eq 0) {
            $row += "`e[93m" + $char + "`e[m"  # Green for boundary points
        } else {
            $row += $char
        }
    }
    
    Write-Output [string]::Join("", $row)
    $progress.Length = $y + 1
}

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "Mandelbrot set generated!" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Output "Complex plane: x ∈ [$xMin, $xMax], y ∈ [$yMin, $yMax]" -ForegroundColor White
'@

# Generate the Mandelbrot art
$script | Set-Content -Path "$PSScriptRoot\Temp\Mandelbrot.ps1"
&"$PSScriptRoot\Temp\Mandelbrot.ps1" 2>&1 | Out-Null
